basic_info.description: Sophisticated, Modern & Luxurious Fully Detached Home in Lakeside Neighborhood! Welcome to this stunningly renovated split-level residence, offering 3BD/3BA/1,724 SQFT of living space on a generous 4,101 SQFT lot.  Completely remodeled from the studs up with all new electrical & plumbing, completed with permits.  Step inside to discover the White Oak hardwood floors, recessed lighting, & abundant natural light flowing through an open and airy floor plan. The main level boasts a spacious living room with 85-inch TV, dramatic chefs kitchen featuring oversized island bar, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, & modern cabinetry, spacious dining area.  Upstairs, youll find two bedrooms & two bathrooms, including a luxurious primary suite designed for comfort and retreat. The lower level offers a third bedroom and full bath, 1-car garage with washer/dryer hookups, EV charge port (240V), & driveway parking.  The oversized low-maintenance backyard is perfect for family gatherings & relaxation, complete with a storage shed.  Ideally located near Stonestown Galleria, Trader Joes, Whole Foods, City Sports, library, park, SFSU, YMCA & top-rated Lowell High. With nearby public transportation & easy freeway access, this home is as convenient as it is beautiful. Must See!
